title: [R] Designing AI Chip Software and Hardware

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My design prioritizes protocol efficiency, not raw compute — unlike TPUs, it scales better for AI workloads. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: GPUs have proven scalability across decades, with CUDA and PCIe support that TPUs and your protocol can’t match. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My software stack integrates directly with memory, reducing latency by 30% — a real-world edge over GPU-based solutions. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Real-world data shows GPUs handle parallel training across thousands of nodes — something your protocol can’t do at scale. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: GPUs win because they’re battle-tested, not because of unproven protocols. (4 sec)

caption_text:
though the design I suggest is not the same as TPUs vs GPUs.

I also included many anecdotes from my career in Silicon Valley.
